description: EF.ATR/INFO served. MF select, SELECT 2F01, then a READ BINARY from offset 0 at the default 0xA0 chunk; the chip answers the whole 19-byte file (card service 43, card capabilities 47, the 7F66 extended-length template with 2048-byte command and response buffers) and the short answer ends the read. No header-length walk: the file is a bare DO sequence with no outer TLV, so selectFileAndRead's DG shape does not apply. runners:["dart"]; upstream has no EF.ATR/INFO read and its selectFileAndRead would truncate the file after its first DO.
